title: Jesus... I'm Scared To Rest Because Everything Might Fall Apart. 🛋️
topic: she is afraid to rest because she believes everything would fall apart without her effort

bible.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm scared to rest because everything might fall apart.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Every time I sit down, my chest tightens. Like the world is only holding together because I keep going.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were never holding it together. I was.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I stop, everything I built could come undone overnight.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Rising early and sitting late was never your assignment. Sleep is a gift, not a wage.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Rest isn't proof you don't care. It's proof you trust Me.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone who forgot how to sit down. 🛋️
